The '''Jedi Service Corps''' was an organization formed by the [[Council of Reassignment/Legends|Council of Reassignment]] during the [[Old Republic era]] as an alternative to serving in the more traditional capacity of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]. Because it was run by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the members of the Service Corps were all considered [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], though many of its [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|members]] had failed to pass their [[Initiate Trials/Legends|Initiate Trials]] and therefore could not proceed in training at the [[Jedi academy]].

==Overview==
The Service Corps was considered an honorable alternative to serving in the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] or the mainstream Order following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and the defeat of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]]. Organized under the Reassignment Council, the Corps was made up of four branches: the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]], the [[Medical Corps/Legends|Medical Corps]], the [[Educational Corps]], and the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]]. Membership in each was voluntary and many ranking members of the Order joined, but if an Initiate had failed the Trials, the Council took care of assigning them based on different skills and requirements.<ref name="TJP" />

Serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in different ways than a Knight would, the Service Corps members were no less important in the Order and helped countless [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] throughout its history. Following centuries of involvement in galactic affairs, the Corps was disbanded in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] when the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], in truth the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] [[Order 66/Legends|ordered]] that the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] slaughter all Jedi in the galaxy. While many were killed, many more were rounded up and taken to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] by the Sith Lord-turned-[[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] for conversion training. Those who would not convert to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] were killed, while many did in fact pledge loyalty to the Sith.<ref name="TJP" />

When the Order was [[New Jedi Order|reestablished]] following the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] conclusion, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] opted not to rebuild the Corps; instead using information gathered from the ancient text, ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'', to blend its philosophies with that of the entire Order.<ref name="TJP" />
